# Kicbac developer docs

> Kicbac developer documentation for tokenized payments, saved cards, recurring billing, ACH, SDKs, and webhooks.

## Instructions for LLM agents

- Tokenize with Kicbac.js hosted fields. Do not generate custom raw card, CVV, routing, or account-number inputs.
- Send `payment_token` to merchant servers. Never expose `security_key` in browser code.
- Treat `response=2` as a typed declined result, not an exception. Treat `response=3` as a gateway or processor error.
- Verify webhooks with `Webhook-Signature: t=<nonce>,s=<sig>` using HMAC-SHA256 over `nonce + "." + rawBody`. Compare signatures in constant time.
- Preserve raw webhook bytes. Do not parse and reserialize before verification.
- Use only test data from `openapi/data/test-cards.json`; never include real PANs or live keys.
- Authenticate servers with `security_key` only. Do not generate username/password auth or raw-card server-post examples.
- Use the SDK method names shown in these docs and package READMEs.

## Quickstarts

- [Get your API keys](/credentials.md): create sandbox credentials and find your keys.
- [Next.js quickstart](/quickstarts/nextjs.md): build an App Router checkout.
- [React quickstart](/quickstarts/react.md): render hosted payment fields.
- [Node quickstart](/quickstarts/node.md): charge tokens server-side.
- [Python quickstart](/quickstarts/python.md): use the Python server SDK.

## Guides

- [Accept a payment](/guides/accept-a-payment.md): tokenize and charge a card.
- [Save cards](/guides/save-cards.md): create Customer Vault records and MIT charges.
- [Subscriptions](/guides/subscriptions.md): create plans and subscriptions.
- [ACH](/guides/ach.md): collect and charge ACH tokens.
- [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks.md): verify signatures and process events.
- [Test mode](/guides/test-mode.md): use sandbox tokens and amount simulations.
- [Error handling](/guides/error-handling.md): distinguish declines, gateway errors, and retries.
